svg.title: omxcore: the Mojo engine (editorial)
svg.desc: The Mojo engine is the core: it links into any app the way SQLite does, and aims to beat DuckDB and Polars on CPU and GPU. Python and apps are plugins. streamed 20M-row query: 0.14 s (DuckDB 0.18 s); NOT EXISTS, 6M x 1.5M rows: 9 ms (DuckDB 35 ms); median, 20M rows, 1M groups: 398 ms (DuckDB 2,208 ms); bigger-than-RAM file, streamed: 1.6 GB (in 72 MB of memory). Informal: a shared 12-core / 24-thread Ryzen with an RTX 3090 while other work ran (load 2 to 10), best or median of a few runs, DuckDB 1.5.1 and pyarrow on the same files in the same minute. The quiet-machine scoreboard has not been run yet.

g.text: A compute engine (CPU and GPU) with persistence to open Parquet
files, in Mojo. Apps and agents build on it; Python is a plugin.
